card.name: Separators inside numbers and codes
card.fires_on: Punctuation or spacing inside numeric strings and identifiers, such as the hyphen in phone numbers, the minus sign before a converted temperature, a slash in a date, or a space before a year or number.

modes.label: Hyphens in phone numbers and temperatures
modes.description: A hyphen or minus sign inside a phone number or before a bracketed second temperature value.

modes.label: Spaces and slashes between numbers
modes.description: A slash or space separating numbers in dates, tables or dose volumes.

card.plain: It fires on the dash, slash or space inside a phone number, date, temperature or number table, just before the next digits.
